content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-122. - Examination.
content.summary:
The board shall have the authority and power to direct that any member be examined
               by two or more physicians or surgeons, to be designated by the board, to determine
               whether or not such member shall be considered disabled, either temporarily or permanently.
            …

faqs.a:
The board shall have the authority and power to direct that any member be examined
               by two or more physicians or surgeons, to be designated by the board, to determine
               whether or not such member shall be considered disabled, either temporarily or permanently.
               Should any member refuse to submit to such medical examination, this shall constitute
               grounds for termination of the member's employment.
(Code 1960, § 19-12; Code 1981, § 26-57)
